name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedLeaf.hop_reveal_of_span
title: If one path row is a combination of the others, its mask is pinned by the noiseless path values
statement: Over a commutative ring R with a finite index type, if c_t = sum_z beta_z c_z, then for all per-path masks M, noise e and matrices A: (M_t + c_t A + e_t) - sum_z beta_z (M_z + c_z A + e_z) = (M_t - sum_z beta_z M_z) + (e_t - sum_z beta_z e_z).
